Definition: properly, what is given (by Providence), i.e. a lot
BiblicalUsage: Yehâb is what is given, the lot that Providence assigns, and it stands once, in the psalm of the man betrayed by his friend. Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and He shall sustain thee, and He shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the burden God gives is the burden He carries, and casting it on Him is the whole of the psalm.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
